text:
Priya Shah: quick sync — onboarding for "argent-20b" showing kv fallthrough logs and RoPE mismatch on canary. We need weights path confirmation and tokenizer quirk repro. Anyone picking this up? :eyes:
Alex Chen: I'll take a look. Where are the weights configured?
Priya Shah: weights in S3 path `s3://redwood-models/argent/20b/v1/weights.bin` — but ops reported a different checksum on instance: `md5: 5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592` vs expected `e99a18c428cb38d5f260853678922e03`. Also canary shows `rope_scale` override 1.0 vs model cfg 1.5.
Dmitri Ivanov: checksum mismatch suggests partial copy. Did the staging deploy use multipart copy? Check `aws s3api head-object` and size. Also tokenizer note: interns saw that leading U+00A0 non-breaking space tokenizes as two tokens with our byte-level tokenizer.
Jamie Lopez: On config validation, the lint currently flags `kv_fallthrough: true` but runtime rejects because `gqa_mode: strict` requires explicit `kv_prefetch` policy. Error snippet:
```
ERROR: kv cache fallthrough prohibited in strict GQA
config: gqa_mode=strict kv_fallthrough=true
```
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5234 for checksum, assigned to Alex Chen.
Alex Chen: grabbing S3 keys now. If it's partial, I'll re-sync and re-run checksum. Also I'll set rope_scale to 1.5 in the serve config and run the lightweight canary.
Priya Shah: also add a quick test for sliding window: `echo "X"*4096 | infer-client --model argent-20b --check-window` to exercise kv boundaries.
Dmitri Ivanov: note for MQA/GQA - when `rope_scale != 1.0` we need to ensure rotary scaling applied in attention kernel. I'll run unit test `tests/rotary/test_scale.py::test_coverage` on canary instance.
Jamie Lopez: tagging @oncall-sre — if Alex re-syncs weights can someone restart the canary? We want <2min downtime.
oncall-sre: I can do the rolling restart. Ping me when weights are verified and config updated.
Alex Chen: re-sync started: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/argent/20b/v1/ /mnt/models/argent/20b/ --recursive` — will post checksum when done.
Priya Shah: thanks — if anyone sees tokenizer split on NBSP, add a quick mapping in `tokenizer_overrides.json` and include in the bundle.
ops-bot: INF-5234 updated: comment "re-sync in progress", will notify.
Alex Chen: done. New md5 `e99a18c428cb38d5f260853678922e03`. Set rope_scale=1.5. Canaries passing sliding-window and kv fallthrough no longer triggered in strict GQA with `kv_prefetch: policy=block`. Canary restart requested.
oncall-sre: restart kicked, canary back up, final smoke passes. :tada:
Priya Shah: awesome — I'll update onboarding checklist and mark ready for prod rollout. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
